abstract: OBJECTIVE: To report a case of mature cystic teratoma of the fallopian tube. DESIGN: Case report. SETTING: Medical college-affiliated hospital. PATIENT(S): A 31-year-old woman, gravida 0, visited our outpatient clinic with infertility. Hysterosalpingography (HSG) showed a swollen right fallopian tube whose patency was not confirmed. INTERVENTION(S): Laparoscopic right salpingectomy was perfomed for a solid-appearing mass ∼2 × 1.5 cm in diameter in the ampullary region. Histopathologic examination showed components from each germ cell layer; therefore, the diagnosis of a mature cystic teratoma of the right fallopian tube was confirmed. The patient became pregnant with IVF-ET and gave birth to a baby boy. CONCLUSION(S): In cases where hydrosalpinx is suspected, a careful assessment by either HSG or laparoscopy is necessary at the time of infertility examination.
abstract_ja: 【目的】卵管の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を報告すること。【設計】症例報告。【設定】医科大学附属病院。【対象】不妊を主訴に外来を受診した31歳の未経妊女性。子宮卵管造影（HSG）で右卵管の腫大が認められ、開通性は確認できなかった。【介入】膨大部に約2×1.5 cmの充実性に見える腫瘤を認め、腹腔鏡下右卵管切除術を施行した。病理組織学的検査で三胚葉すべての成分が認められたため、右卵管の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定診断された。患者は体外受精・胚移植（IVF-ET）で妊娠し、男児を出産した。【結論】不妊の検査で水卵管症が疑われる場合には、子宮卵管造影または腹腔鏡検査による慎重な評価が必要である。
